threadDescriptions.stop-access-audit: Verify step-free access and pavement conditions at civic bus stops
threadDescriptions.address-crosswalk: Reconcile bus-stop identifiers across address and transport datasets
threadDescriptions.public-issue-view: Publish a resident-facing map of audited bus-stop access issues
threadDescriptions.choir-recording: Prepare audio files from a community choir rehearsal
threadDescriptions.survey-training: Train volunteer surveyors to capture consistent bus-stop access observations

items.text: Bus-stop field sheet: Riverside northbound curb step estimated 4 cm. Pavement slopes away from shelter; return with the measuring block.
Transport stop R17 and address record RV-N refer to the same northbound shelter. Add the alias to the identifier crosswalk, keeping both original keys.
Choir rehearsal audio: altos disappear in the group mix. Export a separate alto guide from the close microphone track.
Volunteer survey training needs a short curb-height demonstration. Show where the measuring block touches, and how to record an inaccessible measurement safely.
Resident bus-stop map wireframe: one issue card per audited stop, plain-language access notes and date observed. Unvisited stops must not appear verified.
Riverside northbound remeasure: 7 cm curb step, replacing the 4 cm estimate. The first photo angle hid the lower edge of the kerb.
Crosswalk collision: R17 also appears as an old district address code. Namespace the keys by source so the northbound stop does not absorb a residential address.
Training demo take two: hold the camera level and say the units aloud. Add captions so volunteers can follow without sound.
North / seven / alto?
Choir alto guide exported with count-in and piano reference. Keep the warm-up chatter out of the shared audio folder.
Stop access audit at Mill Close: dropped kerb clear, shelter approach blocked by a temporary fence. Record the observation date because the barrier may move.
Public map test still shows the old Riverside estimate. Replace its issue card with the measured 7 cm value and update the audit's publication-reference field to the new card revision.
items.rationale: Corrects public display and audit publication traceability.

items.text: Address crosswalk review: RV-N maps uniquely to transport:R17; district:R17 stays unmatched. Add this collision example to the crosswalk README.
Two trainee surveyors recorded opposite units on the practice curb. Repeat the measuring exercise and add a required cm field to the training sheet.
Public access map: sort issue cards by stop name, not severity guessed from height alone. Keyboard focus needs to follow the same order.
Choir conductor spotted a missing bar in the alto guide. Restore it from the close microphone track and replace the shared rehearsal file.
Revisited Mill Close: fence removed, shelter approach now clear. Preserve last week's blocked-access photo alongside today's dated observation.
Send the corrected one to everyone before the visit.
Survey training pack ready: captioned curb demo, cm practice sheet and safe-refusal example. Ask new volunteers to complete the exercise before fieldwork.
Resident map release check: unvisited stops labelled not surveyed, every access card dated, keyboard navigation reaches the close button. Ready for publication review.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: these are training-practice observations, not additions to the civic field audit.
